decisions.reason: Adding shower, sink, and door dimension annotations is independently represented by the source Requirement and does not change the floor-plan drawing's required layout content or acceptable format.
The source decision concerns fixture dimension annotations, not the separate furnished drawing or the furnishings and refrigerators it must show.
Annotating shower, sink, and door dimensions does not alter the specified toilet, drain-alignment, or washing-machine locations in the Unit 1 common bathroom.
The annotation request does not change the en-suite bathroom's fixture locations, door locations, or relationship to the common bathroom.
The source adds drawing annotations only and does not resolve or modify the Unit 3 bathroom's drain, shower, toilet, or plumbing-scope state.
Showing fixture dimensions does not change the Unit 2 bathroom placement, toilet constraint, or centered bathroom-door position.
The reference to door dimensions concerns plan annotations and does not change the requirement for one private steel entrance door per dwelling.
The source decision does not change retention or shared use of the existing main entrance door.
Door dimension annotations do not alter the Unit 3 counter arrangement or its bathroom-door clearance strategy.
The source annotation request is unrelated to whether the balcony remains open or is incorporated into the adjacent room.
Adding fixture dimension annotations does not change corridor narrowing, common-entrance partitioning, or allocation of entrance space.
The source decision concerns annotation content and does not modify any wall-preservation, demolition, or construction policy.
